title: CUPID: Contextual Understanding of Prompt-conditioned Image Distributions

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing density-based visual embeddings to detect if attributes specified in a prompt for one object (e.g., color) are inappropriately applied by the model to other unspecified objects.

Using Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) scores and object-level density estimates to identify unnatural correlations between object distance, placement, and camera perspective within generated scenes.

Evaluating image distributions using pointwise mutual information (PMI) and interactive visual exploration to uncover learned model tendencies to position certain generated objects near specific other objects without explicit spatial instructions.
